_note: Overall-score multiplier per movement item: real Phantom+ chase (kill participation) x escape (deaths per 10 min) effect at the same hero, net worth and game length; only parts with |z| >= 2, item floor 1, cap 1.25. Static snapshot of patch 10-30 hotfix Phantom+ games (2026-10-31 to 2026-11-06, fight_rate_post timelines), not refit by patch reruns: rerun kill_participation.py --post on fresh fight_rate_post timelines (or fetch_kda.py + kill_participation.py) to refresh.
_stack_note: Cap on a build's combined value when it holds 2 or 3+ of the movement_items (weighted or not): the measured chase x escape of holding that many vs none (they overlap, so values don't multiply).
_hero_note: hero_items: items that are movement for one hero only (HERO_MOVEMENT), measured the same way on that hero's players.
_close_note: close_items: movement items whose speed comes from weapon hits within radius_m. Their value above 1 is scaled by the hero's reach share at its real median fight distance / holder_share, the holders' mean (a far hero like Vindicta procs Stalker's speed about a quarter as often as the close heroes who buy it).
